detail.command:
printf '
=== STATUS ===
'; git status --short; printf '
=== SOURCE TREE ===
'; find src -maxdepth 4 -type f -print | sort; printf '
=== COURSE/LEVEL API ===
'; for f in $(find src -type f \( -iname '*course*' -o -iname '*level*' -o -iname '*builder*' \) | sort); do echo "--- $f"; sed -n '1,260p' "$f"; done
